name: How does AKN Design Group handle permits and inspections for my project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle permits and inspections for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group manages the complete permit coordination process, from preparing and submitting detailed plans to scheduling and overseeing all necessary inspections. Our integrated design-build approach means we handle the bureaucracy so you don't have to. For example, during a custom kitchen renovation, we ensure all electrical, plumbing, and structural modifications meet current codes and pass inspection. This comprehensive service is part of our commitment to a seamless, managed process, allowing you to focus on the exciting aspects of your renovation without the stress of navigating complex municipal requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group handles all permit coordination, including plan submission and inspection scheduling, as part of our integrated design-build process to ensure compliance.
